description: Committee will not recommend revised intersection design.
Committee recommends original design with Fairlight Crescent right-out for March meeting.

chips.text: Defeated
0 for, 5 against
Councillor Pierce argued removing the Fairlight Crescent right-out would create bottlenecks.
Drivers and pedestrians using 22nd Street and Confederation Drive are affected.
Staff confirmed they still 100% supported the original design with the right-out.
Councillor Pierce questioned for whom traffic operations were considered acceptable.
Public engagement feedback supported including the Fairlight Crescent right-out.
